title: Jubaku Satsu
body:
Syntax: perform jubaku satsu <target>

Description: A binding tree illusion that can stun the target.  Usable with any chakra nature. Base damage: 459-539. 60% chance to inflict stunned. The effect lasts 10 seconds before resistance. Unlocks at level 58. Costs 48 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 9 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
